messages:
alex: Starting prod rollout for release 2026-03-21-rc4 in 5. Change window: 45m. Canaries -> 10% then 50%. I'm going to kick the deploy in 2.

maria: on standby, watching latency and error rates. I'll call quickstop if p50 or p95 spikes. :eyes:

sanjay: +1. quickstop criteria: p95 > 350ms OR 5xx rate > 0.8% for 2 consecutive 1m buckets. Also watch token cost anomaly dashboard.

priya: note: if we quickstop we should pin traffic back to v2026-03-14-hotfix-2 (the last green). I pushed the pin instructions to the runbook.

alex: deploy-bot, start canary for rc4 (region=us-west-2, weight=10%)
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary started for 2026-03-21-rc4 · region=us-west-2 · weight=10% · canary_id=cb-4312349999
deploy-bot: Links: runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/deploy-quickstop · rollback helper: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/rollback-pin 

maria: can see a small blip in p50 now, p95 stable. keeping eyes.

eng-oncall: I'm on call and ready to action quickstop/rollback. If you need me to execute, say "eng-oncall: execute quickstop".

alex: small smoke alert from the assistant service — investigating, do not escalate yet. If it becomes widespread, we'll quickstop.

sanjay: quick note on rollback technique: we prefer pin-and-slow-drain vs full revert. Pin command: `deployctl pin --service assistant --version v2026-03-14-hotfix-2 --reason "quickstop"` — runbook has exact RBAC perms.

maria: telemetry shows increased tail latency for completion endpoint, p95 -> 420ms for 30s window. meeting quickstop criteria.

alex: ok initiating quickstop. eng-oncall: please execute. I'll post release notes link.

eng-oncall: execute quickstop now.

eng-oncall: `deployctl pin --service assistant --version v2026-03-14-hotfix-2 --force --origin cb-4312349999` — completed, traffic pinned back to pinned version and new canary drained.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary cb-4312349999 marked quickstopped by eng-oncall. Traffic pinned to v2026-03-14-hotfix-2. Postmortem checklist: capture spans, heap profiles, and core dumps. https://internal.redwood/incidents/4312349999

priya: filing a short release note entry: "rc4 quickstopped due to elevated assistant p95; pinned to previous stable version. Investigation in progress." I'll attach the perf diffs.

alex: thanks. follow-up actions: 1) collect KV cache hit/miss stats, 2) reproduce load test in staging with same prompt mix, 3) evaluate kernel/quantization differences. Assign owners in the incident doc.

maria: ack. I'll start the perf capture and share logs. :thumbsup:

sanjay: FYI, the rollback-pin runbook also has the fast-abort command if pin fails: `deployctl abort --release 2026-03-21-rc4 --kill-relay` — reserved for when pin can't be applied.

alex: good to know. tagging follow-ups and locking the changelog so no one re-rolls without a postmortem.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Deploy window closed for cb-4312349999. Canary aborted and pinned.

priya: adding timeline to the incident doc and will schedule a short sync in 20m.

eng-oncall: leaving this thread but monitoring. Ping me if you need handoff.

alex: closing thread for now — thanks all. We'll reopen when we have root cause or a safe next rollout plan. :white_check_mark:
